_readme: Outlines for the sales map on reviews.html, already projected to SVG path data (world: Natural Earth projection, 960 wide; us: Albers USA). Made by scripts/geo/make_basemap.py from Natural Earth 1:50m (public domain). Do not hand-edit. Country ids are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes; aliases help scripts/import_etsy_orders.py match the country names in Etsy CSVs.
